{{Quote|We've got the meanest, fiercest, most murderous collection of claws and teeth this side of Portmoak Sector! We have giant sand beetles, battle-trained dewbacks, bone-crunching rancors and even a krayt dragon or two!|[[Galactic Gladiators]]|<ref name="SWG:SDCaWP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Survive Deadly Combat and Win Prize!}}</ref>}}
The '''Portmoak sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]].<ref name="gg9" /> It also neighbored the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]].<ref name="gg11" /> Notable locations in Portmoak included [[Bridin Anchorage]],<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Hyrol Preen Beta]],<ref name="cft" /> [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]], and the [[Jermac system/Legends|Jermac system]].<ref name="gg9" />

==History==
The sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ammar]], a noted art collector.<ref name="stock">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

Before [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] gambler [[Cunbus Locb]] visited several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in this area, earned an amount of money, and left onboard his ship, ''[[Distant Wind]]'', to the chagrin of several fleeced locals. Locb even managed to illegally obtain a [[Flatsculp/Legends|flatsculp]] owned by Ammar, although Ammar then sent his forces after Locb, and they killed him.<ref name="stock" />
